verify_email.subject: Confirm your e-mail for TerraReality
verify_email.text:
Hello{{if .Name}} {{.Name}}{{end}},

please confirm your e-mail address by opening this link:
{{.Link}}

The link is valid for 48 hours. If you did not create an account, ignore this message.

magic_link.subject: Sign in to TerraReality
magic_link.text:
Hello,

open this link to sign in:
{{.Link}}

The link is valid for 15 minutes and works once. If you did not ask to sign in, ignore this message.

password_reset.subject: Reset your TerraReality password
password_reset.text:
Hello,

set a new password here:
{{.Link}}

The link is valid for 1 hour. Changing the password signs you out on all devices. If you did not ask for this, ignore this message.

invitation.subject: Invitation to {{.OrgName}}
invitation.text:
Hello,

{{.InviterName}} invites you to join {{.OrgName}} on TerraReality (role: {{.Role}}).

Accept the invitation here:
{{.Link}}

The invitation is valid for 7 days.

export_ready.subject: Your data export is ready
export_ready.text:
Hello,

the export of your personal data is ready in your privacy settings:
{{.Link}}

The download link is short-lived; it is generated when you download.

erasure_scheduled.subject: Account erasure request received
erasure_scheduled.text:
Hello,

your account will be erased on {{.Date}}. Until then you can cancel the request in your privacy settings:
{{.Link}}

Contract documents are retained for the period required by law.

erasure_rejected.subject: Account erasure could not be completed

sms_code.subject: SMS
sms_code.text: TerraReality: your verification code is {{.Code}}. Valid for 10 minutes.

listing_approved.subject: Listing approved: {{.Title}}

listing_rejected.subject: Listing returned for changes: {{.Title}}

saved_search_digest.subject: New listings for "{{.Name}}" ({{.Count}})
